Resources included (19)

Teacher Presentation slides for the AS Level Business classroom.
All relevant topics covered in the Cambridge International AS Level syllabus.

The full bundle of all AS Level Resources for Teachers of Business.

A total of 19 slideshows spanning the entire AS Level curriculum.

Either you are a teacher or a student, this presentations will save your time and will give you everything you need to teach or to study for a low price.

If you are a teacher this will help your students mastering the key concepts and successfully passing their exams.

It contains editable slides with the whole lessons content, and all you have to do is to adapt it to your needs.

It includes some activities from the textbook, but if you need more revision and practice with answers, please check the revision presentations on my shop.

Unit 1 Business and its environment
1: Enterprise
2: Business structure
3: Size of business
4: Business objectives
5: Stakeholders in a business

Unit 2 People in organisations
10: Management and leadership
11: Motivation
2: Human resource management

Unit 3 Marketing
16: What is marketing?
17: Market research
18: The marketing mix – product and price
19: The marketing mix – promotion and place

Unit 4 Operations and project management
22: The nature of operation
23: Operations planning
24: Inventory management

Unit 5 Finance and accounting
28: Business finance
29: Costs
30: Accounting fundamentals
31: Forecasting and managing cash flows

These presentations cover all of the syllabus points pertinent to Cambridge International Examinations AS Level Business Units 1 through 5 found in the core textbook suggested by CIE.

A total of 19 slideshows spanning the entire AS Level curriculum.
